name: Ravi Voice
description: Talk to the user out loud on their Mac. `ravi voice say --execute --text "..."` publishes on ravi.voice.message; Ravi Voice wakes up and speaks it. Add --reply-to <id> when answering a request that came from Ravi Voice.

emits.when: an agent sends something for the user to hear (voice say)
emits.schema: { appId, correlationId, replyTo?, text, fromSession?, fromAgent?, createdAt }

authentication.reason: Local-only: publishes to the local Ravi NATS bus; the sender is identified by the caller's own context key.

storage.reason: Delivery state lives in the Ravi Voice app (file-drop inbox), not in the app contract.

events.reason: The whole point: ravi.voice.message is consumed by a shell trigger that hands it to the Mac app.

ui.reason: The UI is the voice itself.
